programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: When a local handyman finds a female classics teacher and a member of a group of orchid enthusiasts poisoned in her own home, DCI Barnaby finds himself heading back to Midsomer Malham, the day after he and Joyce had helped out during the village's annual garden show. It is discovered that the victim had a secret lover and had helped to smuggle a rare orchid, the Yellow Roth, out of Borneo. With suspects and motives abounding, the police find themselves dealing with grudges, jealousies, and envy. Where the orchid goes, murders follow.

With suspects and motives abounding, the police find themselves dealing with grudges, jealousies, and envy. Where the orchid goes, murders follow.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: The legendary Big Ten rivalry enters the pickleball arena as the Wisconsin Badgers and Indiana Hoosiers clash in a high-stakes playoff battle at the 2025 DUPR Collegiate Ohio Super Regional. With four coveted bids to the National Championships on the line, elite athletes like Wisconsin’s Noah Havlik and Indiana’s Carter Maris engage in high-octane doubles matches defined by "majestic sorcery" and explosive power. Witness the intensity of collegiate rally scoring where every dink, drive, and around-the-post winner determines which team will punch their ticket to the season finale in April.

Gravel roads, narrow hairpin bends and steep mountain slopes make the highway in British Columbia a particular challenge.

programme.desc: Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Sarah Graham’s Food Safari
programme.desc: We explore Hoboken and learn all about the charm of this famous neighborhood. Starting out the day with the "Mozzeralla Boss" we learn how to make mozzeralla from the king himself. From there we learn more about the history of Hoboken and its famous residents including the late Frank Sinatra. We end our day with art and fresh made delicacys.
